content: Claude Code QA and testing skills ecosystem: community skill packs offer 40 to 50 plus QA and test automation skills covering test generation, bug triage, flaky test detection, and coverage gap analysis that diffs source files versus test files to find untested functions and branches. Typical pattern: an Explore subagent investigates code paths and root cause, then a structured Markdown bug report is written to a dedicated directory with technical analysis, affected files, and proposed fixes. QA engineer skills often enforce coverage thresholds such as 80 percent and produce QA reports in Markdown.
